body: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
plain_description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework that powers trillions of tokens daily for leading AI companies across 400,000+ GPUs. It handles large language models and multimodal models on any hardware—NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Google TPU, or Ascend NPU. The bottom line: production-tested inference at scale, trusted by xAI, NVIDIA, AMD, and more.
technical_description: SGLang is an open-source serving framework for large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models. It provides a Python runtime with RadixAttention for efficient prefix caching, a zero-overhead CPU scheduler, prefill-decode disaggregation, speculative decoding, and structured output generation. The runtime exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and supports tensor, pipeline, expert, and data parallelism across distributed GPU clusters. It integrates with Hugging Face, supports AWQ and GPTQ quantization, and runs on NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, Intel Xeon CPUs, Google TPUs, and Ascend NPUs.
title: SGLang
